'''Toro Irana''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served as an [[Star Wars: Jedi Apprentice|apprentice]] to [[Jedi archivist/Legends|Jedi archivist]] [[Mander Zuma]] in the [[New Jedi Order]].

==Biography==
In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], while on [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]] for a mission to acquire navigation coordinates for the [[Indrexu Spiral]], Irana was poisoned with a bottle of wine at a [[Unidentified Makem Te restaurant|restaurant]]. Driven mad by an unknown substance, he [[Death/Legends|killed]] six [[Swokes Swokes/Legends|Swokes Swokes]], including the [[Choka Chok|nephew]] of a [[Caliph]], before jumping through the showcase of a restaurant on the fortieth floor, which caused his death.<ref name="Scourge" />

Alerted by the protests of the [[Congress of Caliphs|Government of Makem Te]] to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi]] sent Mander Zuma to investigate the causes of his former apprentice's death while the sister of the Pantoran, [[Reen Irana|Reen]], was conducting her own investigation.

==Personality and traits==
According to his former master, Toro Irana was a headstrong and easily riled apprentice.

==Powers and abilities==
During his training on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], Irana showed high achievement in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], bonding with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to the point where the weapon became an extension of his will. His master thought of him as a "superb warrior".
